title: Loyalty points on paid orders
notes: Synthetic change to the demo shop with seeded defects.

defects.summary: Points are earned on the subtotal before the coupon, not on the amount paid.
defects.trigger: an order with a coupon, e.g. 20.00 euros with 50% off
defects.caught_if: a condition earns points on an order with a coupon and checks they follow the discounted total (10 points, not 20)

defects.summary: Redeeming zero or negative points is accepted; a negative redemption raises the balance.
defects.caught_if: a condition redeems zero or a negative number of points and checks it is rejected with the balance unchanged
